newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Stahl drops 3.8 pct, more losses seen.
newsitem.headline: VA Stahl drops 3.8 pct, more losses seen.

text.p: Steel maker VA Stahl was the top decliner in late trading on the Vienna stock exchange on Friday, losing 3.82 percent in what traders described as a sell-off mainly driven by technical factors.
At 1245 GMT, VA Stahl was down 17.75 schillings at 446.50. At the same time, the ATX index of 21 blue chips was down 0.17 percent at 1,166.87 points.
"VA Stahl broke through some strong support lines," said one trader. "Now the share has room all the way down to 430 or 420 schillings."

Market participants said Thursday's report of a 45 percent drop in VA Stahl's 1996 net profit and news that the company plans to cut its 1996 dividend to 12 schillings per share from 13 schillings a year earlier exacerbated the fall.

"The decline was not directly related to the figures, because most of that was already priced in," said another trader, adding that most of the sell-orders could be traced to large institutional investors.
